name: Shaniwar Wada
description: Historic 7-story fortification built in 1732 as the seat of the Peshwas of the Maratha Empire.
historical_facts: Commissioned by Peshwa Baji Rao I in 1730 and completed in 1732. A mysterious fire destroyed major wooden structures in 1828.
price_note: Entry fee for Indian nationals; foreign nationals ₹300
accessibility: Partial wheelchair accessibility at ground level

name: Aga Khan Palace
description: Majestic palace built in 1892 by Sultan Muhammed Shah Aga Khan III; served as a prison for Mahatma Gandhi during the Quit India movement.
historical_facts: Mahatma Gandhi, Kasturba Gandhi, and Mahadev Desai were imprisoned here during 1942–1944. Memorial samadhis are located on campus.
price_note: Entry fee for Indian nationals; foreign nationals ₹300
accessibility: Wheelchair ramps available at main entrance

name: Sinhagad Fort
description: Hill fortress famous for the Battle of Sinhagad in 1670 fought by Tanaji Malusare.
historical_facts: Originally known as Kondhana. Renamed Sinhagad ('Lion Fort') by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in memory of commander Tanaji Malusare.
accessibility: Steep stone steps; not wheelchair accessible

name: Lal Mahal
description: Red brick palace reconstructed in memory of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj who spent his early childhood here.
historical_facts: Original palace was constructed by Shahaji Raje Bhosale in 1630 for his wife Jijabai and son Shivaji. Famous for Shivaji's encounter with Shaista Khan.

name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
description: 8th-century rock-cut cave temple dedicated to Lord Shiva carved out of a single basalt rock.
historical_facts: Carved during the Rashtrakuta period in the 8th century AD. The temple was left unfinished, preserving raw basalt pillar designs.
accessibility: Steps down to cave shrine; limited accessibility

name: Shinde Chhatri
description: Architectural memorial dedicated to 18th-century Maratha commander Mahadji Shinde featuring Anglo-Rajasthani architecture.
historical_facts: Built in 1794. Intricate carved stone pillars and stained glass windows blend Maratha and European styles.

name: Vishrambaug Wada
description: Fine 19th-century three-story mansion built by Peshwa Baji Rao II, known for its carved wooden facade.
historical_facts: Built in 1807 as a residence for Peshwa Baji Rao II. Features signature Maratha teakwood woodwork.

name: Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
description: Famous Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Ganesha, attracting millions of devotees during Ganeshotsav.

name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
description: Museum housing over 20,000 rare Indian artifacts collected by Dr. D.G. Kelkar.

name: Pu La Deshpande Garden
description: Serene Japanese-style garden inspired by Okayama's Korakuen Garden with streams and wooden bridges.

name: Osho Teerth Park
description: Tranquil 12-acre Zen garden created by converting an eco-wasteland into a lush haven.

name: Empress Botanical Garden
description: Sprawling 39-acre historic garden featuring rare flora, huge shade trees, and flower shows.

name: Saras Baug
description: Picturesque park surrounding a lake with the iconic Talyatla Ganpati temple at its center.

name: Vohuman Cafe
description: Iconic Irani cafe legendary for Bun Maska, Cheese Omelette, and Irani Chai.

name: Cafe Goodluck
description: Historic Irani restaurant established in 1935, famous for Keema Pav, Maska Bun, and filter coffee.

name: Cafe Paashh
description: Organic sustainable cafe and concept store housed in a elegant bungalow with courtyard seating.

name: Vaishali Restaurant
description: Beloved South Indian restaurant on FC Road, a legendary student hotspot since 1951.

name: Shabree Restaurant
description: Traditional Maharashtrian restaurant renowned for authentic Thali meals and Puran Poli.

name: Sukanta Thali
description: Popular vegetarian thali restaurant serving unlimited Gujarati and Rajasthani feasts.

name: The Ritz-Carlton Pune
description: Luxury 5-star hotel offering refined suites, fine dining, golf course views, and spa services.

name: JW Marriott Hotel Pune
description: Upscale 5-star luxury hotel on Senapati Bapat Road with multiple specialty dining venues.

name: Hotel Shreyas
description: Well-known heritage business hotel offering comfortable rooms and famous Maharashtrian cuisine.
